changelog:
- Initial release of nanobanana-image skill for advanced AI-based image generation and editing using Google Gemini native image APIs.
- Supports text-to-image, image editing with references, multi-image composition, Google real-time search, YouTube frame-to-image, and up to 4K outputs.
- Command-line interface with flexible parameters for prompt, aspect ratio, model selection, image/video input, and more.
- Includes high-detail "thinking" generation mode and intermediate image output options.
- Requires Python 3.9+, google-genai, Pillow, and a GEMINI_API_KEY.
summary: Image generation and editing based on Google Gemini native image generation (Nano Banana).
